They are all prompting independently, developing their own disparate context, and getting very different results. We’ve invented a new and exciting way not to talk to each other!

blocks.text: The trouble begins when these people actually need to collaborate. That’s when someone has to explain what they did, what they told their agent, what it produced, and how they got there. Their colleague then feeds some rough approximation of that context into their own agent and hopes the important bits survive. They often don’t.

blocks.text: The prompt appeared live on the first laptop, and after submitting it, our newly transplanted Statue of Liberty tripled in size.
